prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art working atlas for NPC 082, guarded emotion, using the supplied reference grid as the exact visual source. Preserve the source face identity, palette, skin shading, both exact guarded upper- and lower-lid contours, eye aperture shape and size, iris size and actual muted gray-blue color, eyebrow shape/placement/expression, and all exterior pixels. Do not enlarge the eyes, expose more sclera, brighten the sclera, or alter the guarded brows.

Canvas: exact 64:35 aspect ratio; 2 columns × 2 rows, no gutters or labels. Top row: LEFT gaze open, RIGHT gaze open. Bottom row: LEFT gaze half-lidded, RIGHT gaze half-lidded. Repeat each eye phase consistently for both eyes. The only open-phase change from the reference is a very gentle lateral glance of about one native pixel: pupils/irises move left in the left cells and right in the right cells, remaining fully inside the existing apertures. Keep iris shape and size unchanged. Use muted beige sclera and only tiny subdued natural glints; no bright white bands, no large glossy highlights, no broad exposed sclera. Half-lid phases must retain the exact source eyelid contour and lower the existing upper lid naturally; no new eye geometry.

Keep the image crisp, low-resolution pixel art with stepped native contours, no smoothing, no painterly detail, no text, no extra panels, no background or face redesign.
